verdict.rationale: Column documents sending and receiving international transfers through SWIFT via its API, claims access to over 150 global currencies, and notes it receives full raw data for international wires. The evidence shows nothing on FX rate transparency (rates, spreads, quotes) and no published map of supported currencies or corridors beyond the headline count. Missing for 10: transparent FX rate and quote documentation, a detailed currency/corridor coverage map, independent or hands-on corroboration of international wires.
